d.d: A disease caused by coenurosis of the brain, most commonly found in sheep and canids.
A feeling of being overcome with excitement, especially in a silly or immature manner.
Feeling a sense of spinning in the head, causing a perception of unsteadiness and being about to fall down; dizzy.
d.x: The man became giddy upon standing up so fast.

d.d: Causing or likely to cause dizziness or a feeling of unsteadiness.
d.x: They climbed to a giddy height.

d.d: Moving around something or spinning rapidly.
